title: Synthetic implementation-evidence lifecycle demonstration
purpose: Demonstrate source-grounded pairwise comparison across three clearly differentiated fictional implementation stages

criteria.name: Documented implementation maturity
criteria.rubric: Compare only the implementation evidence explicitly published in each registered source. A runnable implementation with passing tests and working integration examples demonstrates more current implementation maturity than design and milestone documents without runnable code; design and milestone documents demonstrate more maturity than a concept with no architecture, milestones, or implementation artifacts. Do not infer unpublished evidence or reward future potential.

candidates.name: FieldNote
candidates.summary: Fictional runnable reference implementation with regression tests and integration examples

candidates.name: PlanForge
candidates.summary: Fictional design-stage proposal with architecture and milestones

candidates.name: IdeaBoard
candidates.summary: Fictional early concept without implementation artifacts
